title: No more signposts
notes: The world shows you what's happening instead of telling you: wind blows dust past, a falling slab casts its shadow where it will land, the groove pulses on the beat, and frost blooms when the slab holds at the wall.
New rules show themselves once: time slows and a ghostly slab makes the move for you.
Perfect hits burst with a painted flare; keystones gleam with gold; the bomb is a sizzling charge with a ring of fire for its fuse. The pickups and play-by-play labels are gone.
